headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PIA (7)

summary: Lando Norris won the Miami Grand Prix from P5 on the grid, 7.6s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Fernando Alonso made the biggest climb, from P15 to P9.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P6 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised MAG (10 second time penalty) and STR (10 second time penalty).
There were 28 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 35 points over Sergio Perez.
